name: Dayoon
source:
He is often a simple, easy-going man, but his exact personality details and usage are variable with his role and he is officially described by Fujio Pro as an unclear man whose identity cannot be easily understood.

Dayoon is best known for ending his sentences in "dayoon" or simply "yon".
